terminals.name: Revierkaia Cruise Quay
terminals.notes: Central Oslo cruise quay near Bjørvika.

terminals.name: Filipstad Cruise Terminal
terminals.notes: Western Oslo cruise berth with a separate passenger exit and shuttle area.

pois.name: Botanisk hage
pois.description: Norway's oldest botanical garden, established in 1814. About 35 000 plants, distributed in about 7,500 different species or varieties. (website)
pois.intro: The University Botanical Garden is Norway's oldest botanical garden. It was first established in 1814 and is administered by the University of Oslo.

pois.name: Astrup Fearnley Museet
pois.description: A privately owned museum, which presents temporary exhibitions of international art. First opened in 1993 in Dronningensgtate 4.
pois.intro: The Astrup Fearnley Museum is a privately owned contemporary art museum in Oslo in Norway. It was founded and opened to the public in 1993.

pois.name: Lorry
pois.intro: Lorry er en tradisjonsrik restaurant beliggende i Parkveien 12 i Oslo. Den har vært i drift siden midten av 1870-tallet og er særlig kjent for de mange kunstnerne som har besøkt stedet, et sortiment på over 215 ølsorter og kunstsamlingen bestående av 350 verker.

pois.name: Operahuset i Oslo
pois.intro: The Oslo Opera House is the home of the Norwegian National Opera and Ballet, and the national opera house in Norway. The building is situated in the Bjørvika neighbourhood of central Oslo, at the head of the Oslofjord.

pois.name: Akershus slott
pois.intro: Akershus Fortress or Akershus Castle is a medieval castle in the Norwegian capital Oslo that was built to protect and provide a royal residence for the city. It is located on the banks of the Oslofjord.

pois.name: Munchmuseet
pois.intro: Munch Museum, marketed as MUNCH since 2020, is an art museum in Bjørvika, Oslo, Norway, dedicated to the life and works of the Norwegian artist Edvard Munch. The Munch Museum exhibits the full breadth of Edvard Munch’s works, along with contemporary art exhibitions.

pois.name: Oslo domkirke
pois.intro: Oslo Cathedral — formerly Our Savior's Church — is the main church for the Church of Norway Diocese of Oslo, as well as the parish church for downtown Oslo. The present building dates from 1694 to 1697.

pois.name: Det kongelige slott
pois.intro: The Royal Palace in Oslo is the official residence of the Norwegian monarch. It was built in the first half of the 19th century as the Norwegian residence of the French-born Charles XIV John, who reigned as king of Norway and Sweden.

pois.name: Oslo rådhus
pois.intro: Oslo City Hall is a municipal building in Oslo, the capital of Norway. It houses the city council, the city's administration and various other municipal organisations.

pois.name: Framhuset;Frammuseet
pois.intro: The Fram Museum is a museum telling the story of Norwegian polar exploration. It is located on the peninsula of Bygdøy in Oslo, Norway.

pois.name: Nobels Fredssenter
pois.openingHours: Jan 1 off; Jan 2‑6 Mo off; Jan 2‑6 Tu‑Su 11:00‑17:00; Jan 7‑May 31 Mo off; Jan 7‑May 31 Tu 11:00‑17:00; Jan 7‑May 31 We 11:00‑20:00; Jan 7‑May 31 Th‑Su 11:00‑17:00; May 1 11:00‑17:00; May 20 11:00‑13:00; Jun 1‑Aug 31 Mo‑Su 10:00‑18:00; May 17 off; Dec 9 o
pois.intro: The Nobel Peace Center in Oslo, Norway, is a showcase for the Nobel Peace Prize and the ideals it represents. The center is also an arena where culture and politics merge to promote involvement, debate and reflection around topics such as war, peace and conflict resolution.

pois.name: Vikingskipshuset
pois.intro: The Viking Ship Museum is located on the Bygdøy peninsula in Oslo, Norway. It is temporarily closed from September 2021 until 2027.

pois.name: Kon-Tiki Museet
pois.description: Thor Heyerdahl (1914-2002) gained worldwide fame when he crossed the Pacific Ocean on Kon-Tiki in 1947 and followed up with spectacular expeditions on the reed boats Ra and Tigris.
pois.intro: The Kon-Tiki Museum is a museum in the Bygdøy peninsula in Oslo, Norway. It houses vessels and maps from the Kon-Tiki expedition, as well as a library with about 8,000 books.

pois.name: Norsk Folkemuseum
pois.nameEnglish: The Norwegian Museum of Cultural History
pois.description: Landets største kulturhistoriske museum med verdens første friluftsmuseum og store innendørs utstillinger.
pois.intro: Norsk Folkemuseum, at Bygdøy, Oslo, Norway, is a museum of cultural history with extensive collections of artifacts from all social groups and all regions of the country. It also incorporates a large open-air museum with more than 150 buildings, relocated from towns and rural districts.

pois.name: Nasjonalgalleriet
pois.intro: The National Gallery is a gallery in Oslo, Norway. Since 2003 it is administratively a part of the National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design.

pois.name: Frognerparken
pois.intro: Frogner Park is a public park in the central West End borough of Frogner in Oslo, Norway. The park is historically part of Frogner Manor and is Oslo's largest park, open to the public at all times.

pois.name: Kulturhistorisk museum
pois.description: Includes Egyptioan mummies and the only complete Viking helmet ever found
pois.intro: Museum of Cultural History is an association of museums subject to the University of Oslo, Norway. KHM was established in 1999 as Universitetets kulturhistoriske museum with the merging of the bodies Universitetets Oldsaksamling which housed a collection of ancient and medieval objects, Viking Ship Museum at Bygdøy, the Coin Cabinet and Ethnographic Museum.

pois.name: Lystslottet Oscarshall
pois.description: Royal summer palace. Built by Oscar I 1847 - 1852 and is "finest example of Neo-Gothic architecture in Norway." Open as a museum since 1881.
pois.intro: Oscarshall is a maison de plaisance located in the small fjord Frognerkilen on Bygdøy in Oslo, Norway.

pois.name: Norges hjemmefrontmuseum
pois.intro: Norway's Resistance Museum also known as the Norwegian Home Front Museum is a museum located at the Akershus Fortress in Oslo. The museum collection focuses on Norwegian resistance during the occupation of Norway by Nazi Germany from 1940 to 1945.

pois.name: Forsvarsmuseet
pois.intro: The Armed Forces Museum of Norway is a museum located at Akershus Fortress in Oslo, Norway. Previously it was named Hærmuseet, The Army Museum.

pois.name: Norsk Maritimt Museum
pois.intro: The Norwegian Maritime Museum is located at Bygdøynesveien on the Bygdøy peninsula, on the western side of Oslo, Norway. The Norwegian Maritime Museum is situated near several other museums, including the Fram Museum; the Kon-Tiki Museum; the Norwegian Museum of Cultural History; and the Viking Ship Museum.

pois.name: Vigelandmuseet
pois.description: The Vigeland Museum is the sculpture museum of Oslo and is dedicated to sculptor Gustav Vigeland.
pois.intro: The Vigeland Museum is a museum dedicated to Gustav Vigeland in Frogner, Oslo. It is located outside Frogner Park, which includes the Vigeland installation with sculptures by Gustav Vigeland.

pois.name: Nordisk bibelmuseum
pois.intro: The Nordic Bible Museum, located in Oslo, Norway, is the first Bible museum in the Nordic countries.

pois.name: Naturhistorisk museum
pois.nameEnglish: Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo
pois.wikipedia: en:Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo
pois.intro: The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway's oldest and largest museum of natural history. It is situated in the neighborhood of Tøyen in Oslo, Norway.

pois.name: Senter for studier av Holocaust og livssynsminoriteter
pois.nameEnglish: Holocaust museum at the Center for Studies of Holocaust and Religious Minorities
pois.intro: The Center for Studies of the Holocaust and Religious Minorities is a Norwegian research institution. It is organised as an independent foundation and is an affiliated institute of the University of Oslo.

pois.name: Maaemo
pois.intro: Maaemo is a three-Michelin-star restaurant in Oslo, Norway. The name Maaemo derives from the Finnish language, meaning "Mother earth".

pois.name: Asylet
pois.intro: Asylet is the popular name of a building located at Grønland 28 in Oslo, Norway.

pois.name: Theatercaféen
pois.intro: Theatercaféen is a restaurant located in the Hotel Continental in Oslo, Norway.

pois.name: Engebret Kafé
pois.intro: Engebret Café is a restaurant located at Bankplassen 1 in downtown Oslo, Norway. The food is based on exclusive Norwegian cuisine.

pois.name: Stortorvets Gjæstgiveri
pois.intro: Stortorvets Gjæstgiveri is a traditional Norwegian restaurant house in Oslo, Norway. It is located in a building from the early 18th century that is cultural heritage site.

pois.name: Statholdergaarden
pois.intro: Statholdergaarden is a gourmet restaurant in the Kvadraturen sector of central Oslo, Norway. The restaurant is led by Bocuse d'Or winning chef Bent Stiansen and his wife Anette Stiansen until her death in May 2010.

pois.name: Grand Café
pois.intro: Das Grand Café in Oslo ist ein traditionelles Kaffeehaus. Es wurde 1874 von dem Konditor Julius Fritzner gegründet und befindet sich im Gebäude des Grand Hotels an der Adresse Karl Johans gate Nr.

pois.name: Vesuvio Vista Mare
pois.description: Vesuvio Cafè & Pizzeria er et familiedrevet italiensk pizzeria som har blitt en lokal favoritt i Oslo.

pois.name: Arv Kaffe & Retro
pois.description: Cafe, bar, and retro shop. has quiz nights and music at times as well.

pois.name: Prindsen hage
pois.description: En sommerkafé. Tilbyr diverse utendørs spill. Bestilling av bane og bord om ønskelig. https://www.prindsenhage.no/ https://www.facebook.com/pg/prindsenhage/about/

pois.name: Paleet Shopping
pois.intro: Paléet was a monumental single storey townhouse located in the Norwegian capital Oslo that for a long time functioned as a residence for the Norwegian royalty.

pois.name: Oslo City
pois.intro: Oslo City is one of the largest shopping centres in central Oslo, Norway. The shopping centre was built in 1988, and is visited by c.

pois.name: Glasmagasinet
pois.intro: Glasmagasinet of GlasMagasinet is een winkelcentrum op Stortorvet in Oslo. Jarenlang was hier het warenhuis Christiania Glasmagasin gevestigd, ook wel bekend als Glasmagasinet.

pois.name: Byporten Shopping
pois.intro: Byporten är ett köpcentrum sammanlänkat med Oslo Sentralstasjon. Det ligger vid Jernbanetorget i centrala Oslo.

pois.name: Platekompaniet
pois.description: Musikkbutikk som selger LP, CD, videospill, DVD, Blu-Ray.
pois.intro: Platekompaniet er en norsk butikkjede som selger musikk, film og spill.

pois.name: Tronsmo Bokhandel
pois.intro: Tronsmos bokhandel, ofte bare kalt Tronsmo, er en uavhengig bokhandel i Universitetsgata 12 i Oslo. Bokhandelen har en erklært tilknytning til venstresiden i norsk politikk og samfunnsdebatt, men har også et godt omdømme blant samfunns- og litteraturinteresserte uavhengig av politisk legning.

pois.name: Norli Litteraturhuset
pois.intro: Litteraturhuset er et nasjonalt aktivitets- og kulturhus med fokus på litteratur og bøker. Det ble åpnet i 2007 og ligger i strøket bak Slottet ved Slottsparken i Oslo.

pois.name: Eidsvolls plass
pois.intro: Eidsvolls plass is a square and park in Oslo, Norway, located west of the Parliament of Norway Building, south of Karl Johans gate and east of Studenterlunden and the National Theatre. It has been referred to as "the National Mall of Norway".

pois.name: Middelalderparken
pois.intro: The Medieval Park is located in the borough of Gamle Oslo in Oslo, Norway. The park was opened in the year 2000 at Sørenga in what was once the southern part of the medieval city of Oslo.

pois.name: Olaf Ryes plass
pois.intro: Olaf Ryes plass is a square and park placed centrally in the Grünerløkka borough of Oslo, Norway. It is more or less square in shape.

pois.name: Minneparken
pois.intro: Minneparken is situated in Gamle Oslo adjacent to Oslo torg at Gamlebyen in Oslo, Norway. The park is bounded by St.

pois.name: Studenterlunden
pois.intro: Studenterlunden is a park in the city center of Oslo, Norway. Studenterlunden is surrounded by four streets; Karl Johans gate, Stortingsgata, Frederiks gate and Roald Amundsens gate.

pois.name: Ekebergskråningen naturreservat
pois.intro: Ekebergskråningen, eller Ekebergskråninga, er et naturområde på cirka 800 dekar i tilknytning til Oslo indre by. Skråningen ligger dels i bydel Gamle Oslo, dels i bydel Nordstrand og utgjør den solfylte vesthellinga av Ekeberg, som skråner ned mot Oslofjorden og Bjørvika.

pois.name: Malmøya og Malmøykalven naturreservat
pois.intro: Malmøya og Malmøykalven Nature Reserve is a nature reserve established in 2008 in the municipality of Oslo, Norway. The nature reserve consists of parts of the island of Malmøya, the island of Malmøykalven, and a water zone which includes the skerries of Malmøyskjær and Hertugskjær.

pois.name: Dronningberget naturreservat
pois.intro: Dronningberget er en kolle på Bygdøy i bydel Frogner i Oslo, som ble opparbeidet som park på 1700-tallet. Istandsetting og tilbakeføring av Dronningberget som park var Regjeringens gave til kong Harald V og dronning Sonjas 70-års fødselsdager hhv.

pois.name: Brannfjell
pois.intro: Brannfjell er et høydedrag øst og syd for Ekebergsletta i Oslo. Det har en største høyde på 205 meter over havet.

pois.name: Lindøya naturreservat
pois.intro: Lindøya naturreservat omfatter den midtre og nordlige del av Lindøya i Oslo. Naturreservatet ble opprettet den 9.juli 1993.

pois.name: Galteskjær biotopvernområde
pois.intro: Galteskjær er en holme rett ved skipsleia nordvest for Lindøya i Oslo. Skjæret er fra 19.

pois.name: Havnepromenaden infotårn 4 Vika
pois.intro: Havnepromenaden er en ca. 9 kilometer lang, sammenhengende promenade langs hele sjøkanten i det sentrale Oslo, fra Alnas utløp i Grønlia i øst, gjennom Oslo sentrum med Bjørvika, Akersneset og Pipervika og til bunnen av Frognerkilen.

pois.name: Ruter S
pois.description: Ruter Help Center, Public Transport Help Center

pois.name: Kunstnernes hus
pois.intro: Kunstnernes Hus is an art gallery in Oslo, Norway. It is Norway's largest gallery under the direction of artists, and has served as a major center for exhibits of Norwegian and international contemporary art.

pois.name: Hovedøya kloster
pois.intro: Hovedøya Abbey was a medieval era Cistercian monastery on the island of Hovedøya in Oslofjord outside of Oslo, Norway.

pois.name: Jernbanetorget
pois.intro: Jernbanetorget or Jernbanetorvet is both a rapid transit station on the Oslo Metro and a tram stop of the Oslo Tramway. The metro station is in the Common Tunnel used by all lines under the city centre.

pois.name: Stortorvet
pois.intro: Stortorvet is a square in Oslo, Norway, located west of Oslo Cathedral.

pois.name: Bankplassen
pois.intro: Bankplassen is a square in the neighborhood Kvadraturen in Oslo, bounded by Kongens gate, Myntgata and Kirkegata. Before 1953, Agnes Thorsens plass was also part of Bankplassen.

pois.name: Oslo Reptilpark
pois.intro: Oslo Reptilpark er en privateid norsk dyrepark, og Norges eneste reptilpark. Parken åpnet i Storgata 26 i januar 2002, men flyttet til nåværende adresse høsten 2007.

pois.name: Thon Senter Gunerius
pois.intro: Gunerius Shoppingsenter is one of the largest shopping centres in Oslo, Norway, with c. 18,000 visitors a day – 5,5 million a year.

pois.name: CC Vest
pois.intro: CC Vest is a Norwegian shopping centre in Lilleaker, Oslo. It has 78 outlets, and mainly serves western Oslo as well as eastern Bærum.

terminalResolution.notes: Sondre Akershuskai, Revierkaia, and Filipstad are all Oslo cruise quays.
